name: @kealthas-dev/opencode-gitbash-edit-path-fix
description: gitbash-edit-path-fix.ts opencode plugin (rewrites Git-Bash/MSYS/Cygwin/WSL-style absolute paths like "/c/Users/x" to "C:/Users/x" before the built-in "edit" tool runs on Windows, working around anomalyco/opencode#22799 whose fix in #22800 was closed without merging), published to npm so opencode's own npm-plugin loader can install it directly from a bare package name in opencode.json's plugin array - see CLAUDE.md. Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type.
